verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe recurring cron and one-time schedules with notification preferences and agent selection, exposed through its MCP server. They also cover Auto-Fix, which responds to review comments and iterates on CI failures on its own. Further support comes from cloud handoff of long tasks, parallel sessions, and an API for automating workflows. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party scheduling/automation guide beyond the MCP tool descriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled background runs work reliably.
